description:
This protocol automates the distribution of samples from a 96-well plate (on the Temperature Module) to a 384-well plate.

Given the mapping differences between a 96-well plate and a 384-well plate, the user can specify to transfer to odd rows (A/C/E...) or even rows (B/D/F...).

This protocol uses a custom labware definition for the Greiner Bio-One 384-well plate. When downloading the protocol, the labware definition (a JSON file) will be included for use with this protocol. For more information on using custom labware on the OT-2, please see this article: Using labware in your protocols


To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)
Opentrons P300 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 300µL Tips
Opentrons Temperature Module
96-Well Aluminum Block
96-Well Plate
Greiner Bio-One 384-well plate



Slot 1: Greiner Bio-One 384-well plate
Slot 2: Opentrons 300µL Tips
Slot 4: Opentrons Temperature Module with 96-Well Aluminum Block & 96-Well Plate containing samples in columns 1-8


Using the customizations field (below), set up your protocol.
 Destination Rows: Specify which rows the multi-channel pipette will dispense in.
 P300-Multi Mount: Select which mount (left or right) the P300-Multi is attached to.

src_cols.labware: Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with NEST Well Plate 100 µL on Temperature Module GEN1
